verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe streaming input mode as the preferred method for real-time interactive apps, a dedicated streaming-output guide showing how to enable token-level streaming via include_partial_messages/includePartialMessages, plus hooks and canUseTool callbacks that surface tool-call and step events during execution, directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of real-time UI streaming quality, and no explicit end-to-end UI code example beyond flag/callback docs
